found_by: running the six-company matrix under the completed D02 capacity route; two companies refuse most of their positions
what_it_is: A development gap, named as one. When the selected target period carries an amendment, the historical route refuses rather than choosing a target, so the coordinate produces no result. This is correct behaviour under the project rule that an unimplemented route must not be reported as a disclosure problem - but it is a gap to close, not a source limitation.

existing_material.its_own_statement: 'This additive source component is not wired into the running V14 batch. ... No metric value or Run is created here.'
existing_material.so: the ordinary route has amendment scope inspection as a source component and has not wired it into a Run either. Closing the historical gap is not a matter of calling an existing wired route.

why_it_is_not_purely_mechanical: Which filing is the target when a period carries a 10-K/A is a business question, and the repository already treats it as one: AGENTS.md records that limited link corrections may reach B01/B03, the six events and Company Facts, while Part III does not automatically approve a financial or subject-consolidation scope. Porting that into the historical route means deciding, per metric family, which amendment content is in scope for a pinned past period - and a pinned past period is exactly where a later amendment is most likely to change the answer.

resolution.what_was_wrong_with_the_finding_above: It recorded the gap as a business question needing a decision. The decision was already taken: config/annual_amendment_scope_v1.json is approved and its patterns are these two filings' own wording. Reading each amendment's explanatory note confirms neither changes what the refused metrics read.

southwest_airlines.reading: the policy clears both input classes, and it did

HISTORICAL_AMENDMENT_INPUT_CLASS_NOT_CLE.is: the approved policy deciding, not a gap. Part III does not automatically approve a financial or subject-consolidation scope.

HISTORICAL_ZERO_AI_SUCCESSOR_SCOPE_NOT_I.is: a second, independent implementation gap that the amendment guard had been masking. Paramount's subject_policy mode is SUCCESSOR_REGISTRANT_ONLY - CIK 2041610 with registered predecessor 813828 - and the zero-AI historical route requires CONTINUOUS_PRIMARY.

resolution.a_prediction_that_was_wrong: Paramount was predicted at 10 of 23 - four already passing plus six event metrics the policy clears. It came out at 4. The policy did clear the event window; the event metrics are stopped by the successor-registrant guard instead. The prediction was made from one guard while two apply, which is the same error as reading a first blocking reason as the only blocker.
